analytic_review: The degree-three orthonormal Hermite patterns (3),(2,1),(1,1,1) have factors1/6,1/2,1. Independence survives product-cell conditioning. Expanding the elementary symmetric cubic gives the stated O(d) expression; point substitution gives the displayed kernel. Gaussian interval moments follow by integration by parts. Antipodal odd-cell features are2 times their cell integrals, hence weights w_C=2 gamma(C) give exactly the folded matrix entry.
scope: An arbitrary-dimensional algebra identity. No new norm cap, density assertion, or convergence rate is introduced.
